title: Module 5 Current — History Comparison (historical / Influx)
description:
Module vs **its own 30-day history** (same meaning as live **History Comparison**), for dates before Prometheus retention.

| Series | Source |
|--------|--------|
| Actual | Influx tag `machine` + `_field` |
| Upper / Lower / Expected | Influx `ml_predictions` from ML exporter **backfill** (`upper`, `lower`, `expected`) |

Not peer ±2σ and not `model=peer_rf`. Use the **dashboard** time picker only — no panel timeFrom/timeTo.

Replace `Module5_Current_A` / title for other modules. Datasource UID = same as working Module 5 peer-band Flux panel.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.machine == "2406-176021" and
    r._field == "Module5_Current_A"
  )
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Module 5 (Actual)" }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "upper")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Upper Bound (RF)")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lower")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Lower Bound (RF)" }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "expected")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Expected (RF)" }))
